final: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avgshare FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avgshare FROM a)
